test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

One's cup of tea
solution: The correct answer is **One's chosen or preferred thing.** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom is One's chosen or preferred thing. • **One's cup of tea** means **Something that one prefers, seeks, appreciates, or is concerned about. (**कोई ऐसी चीज जिसे कोई पसंद करता है, चाहता है, उसकी सराहना करता है या जिसके बारे में चिंतित है।) **Frequently used in the negative to denote the inverse.(**अक्सर नकारात्मक में उपयोग किया जाता है) • Thus the correct answer is** **One's chosen or preferred thing.​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • One's cup of tea's example- • ​*The pier was obscured by morning fog and it felt nice to get a **cup of tea** before starting to fish.* • *Fran's suggestions are steak and mushroom pie and Banoffi pie, sticky toffee and banana pudding, not everybody's **cup of tea.*** 3c:Tc84, The correct answer is **'thrifty'. (**मितव्ययी)
